allowedOnlyWhen: source URL resolves to an individual work or edition record
document-level rights or public-domain evidence is explicit for the intended jurisdiction and Dawn use
edition identity is recoverable from independent source metadata
source provider and every source authority marker are outside the permanent Wikisource denylist
never: infer public-domain status from provider alone
admit any zh-wikisource or *.wikisource.org source, including stale or rewritten candidates
promote a chapter or fragment as an independent library book without work-level identity
